primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: V_RT: Velocity vector of Right Tackle (m/s). Theta: Angular deviation from optimal path (radians).
primitives.assumptions: Players maintain constant relative velocity during the curve; friction with defenders is linear.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur if the Right Half is immediately tackled, collapsing the vector field.

primitives.name: Asymmetric Block Allocation Matrix
primitives.verbatim_quote: Right Half Back leads the interference and blocks the opposing half back.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: M_block: Blocking assignment matrix (dimensionless). F_impact: Impact force (Newtons).
primitives.assumptions: Perfect coordination between Right Half Back and Right Tackle; no missed assignments.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the opposing half back blitzes unexpectedly, violating the assumed spatial partition.
